homePage.heroTagline: Bois la potion. Interprète le rôle. Gravis les Séquences de 9 vers la divinité, avant que la Brume ne te réclame.
homePage.circleTitle: Tous les pouvoirs du roman. Jouables.
homePage.circleLede: Notre plugin personnalisé implémente tout le système de pouvoirs Beyonder : 22 Voies, potions, rituels, Interprétation et perte de contrôle. Aucun mod requis ; un compagnon côté client ajoute les effets visuels.
homePage.circleStepOneBody: Pille des coffres qui se remplissent, échange avec des joueurs ou chasse des créatures mystiques afin d’obtenir une formule de potion de Séquence 9 de l’une des 22 Voies.
homePage.circleStepTwoBody: Réunis les ingrédients principaux, utilise le chaudron et avale ton destin. De vraies capacités, un coût en spiritualité et une vraie folie si tu te précipites.
homePage.circleStepThreeBody: Digère la potion en vivant le rôle de ta Séquence. Accomplis des rituels, progresse en Interprétation et gravis les Séquences de 9 → 0 au cours d’une saison.
homePage.observatoryLede: Recensement en direct de chaque joueur éveillé cette saison : les Voies qu’ils parcourent et jusqu’où ils se sont élevés. Mis à jour chaque heure depuis le serveur.
homePage.observatoryRegistryCta: Les sièges des Séquences 3–0 sont limités : consulter le Registre des Ascensions
homePage.newsEyebrow: Depuis l’autre côté de la Brume
homePage.closingLede: Rejoins-nous gratuitement. Avec Java 26.1.2+, accepte le pack de ressources : ta première Séquence n’est plus qu’à une soirée.

companion.title: COI Client
companion.lede: Mysterria fonctionne parfaitement avec un client Minecraft classique : chaque mécanique Beyonder se trouve sur le serveur. Le Client COI est un petit mod facultatif qui ajoute la seule chose qu’un client vanilla ne peut afficher : la magie elle-même.
companion.featureHotkeysBody: Associe tes capacités à des raccourcis et lance-les en plein combat sans jamais ouvrir de menu.
companion.featureVisualsBody: Cercles rituels, sigils et effets de lancement entièrement rendus sur ton propre client.
companion.featurePresenceBody: Une ambiance sonore propre au serveur, ainsi qu’une riche présence Discord affichant ta Séquence.
companion.platformNote: Dernière version · s’installe aux côtés du pack de ressources du serveur
companion.optional: Rien sur le serveur n’est verrouillé derrière le mod et il ne te sera jamais demandé de l’installer. Choisis simplement la plateforme que tu utilises déjà : les trois proposent la même version.

terms.title: Commission du système magique
terms.whatIsIt: Un service de développement sur mesure qui permet aux pratiquants de la magie de demander des ajustements ciblés et fidèles au lore sur des sorts, mécaniques ou capacités existants – évalués par nos testeurs et développeurs, puis implémentés directement par notre équipe technique.
requestOptions: Un budget commun de 6 points par demande – une modification majeure coûte 3 points, une modification mineure 1.
Jusqu’à 2 modifications majeures – une réécriture complète pour l’alignement sur le lore, une refonte d’équilibrage d’une capacité, ou l’ajout d’un nouveau sort ou d’une mise à l’échelle.

Jusqu’à 6 modifications mineures – petits ajustements de valeurs (temps de recharge, dégâts, coût en mana, constantes de mise à l’échelle) ou légères retouches de lore, sur un ou plusieurs sorts ou capacités.
Combine-les librement dans la limite du budget – p. ex. 1 majeure + 3 mineures consomment les 6 points, tout comme 2 majeures ou 6 mineures seules.
requirements: Justifiée – explique le raisonnement de jeu ou de lore qui la motive.
Fidèle au lore – ancrée dans l’univers établi ou le matériau source, pas inventée de toutes pièces.
Non fondamentale – aucune refonte des systèmes centraux ni modification de l’architecture.

Respectueuse du travail récent – ne demande pas de refaire un sort ou une capacité retravaillé récemment et actuellement bien équilibré, juste pour une autre interprétation. Si depuis il est réellement déséquilibré, obsolète ou défectueux – peu importe qui y a touché en dernier – tu peux légitimement en faire la demande.
howItWorksSteps: Les testeurs et développeurs évaluent sa faisabilité et sa fidélité au lore (vérification du staff).
Les demandes approuvées sont planifiées et implémentées.
Tu reçois une notification quand elle est disponible.
terms.note: Les demandes qui dépassent ce cadre seront réparties sur plusieurs commissions – nous te dirons exactement combien avant tout paiement supplémentaire.

hero.lede: Mysterria is a Minecraft MMORPG set in Lord of the Mysteries. Choose one of 22 Pathways, brew its potions, act out its role and rise from Sequence 9 toward godhood.
hero.fanLabel: The deck of 22 Pathways. Pick a face-down card to draw it.
hero.undrawn: Each card is one of the 22 Pathways
hero.hint: Or pick any card from the ring. The page takes on its colours and powers.

dock.label: Pathway card
dock.drawFirstHint: Pick one of the 22 Pathways at random

deck.lede: Pick a seal to see how a Pathway starts, how far it climbs and its first abilities. Each one has its own page with every Sequence.
deck.ringPathways: The 22 Pathways. The checked seal is the one shown below.
deck.ringBoons: The 10 Boons. The checked seal is the one shown below.
deck.hint: Drag the ring or use the arrow keys
deck.hintTouch: Swipe the ring or tap a seal
deck.boonNote: A Boon is a shorter path beside the 22 Pathways. It runs from Sequence 9 to Sequence 5.
deck.climb: From {first} at Sequence 9 to {last} at Sequence {top}.

progression.title: Start at Sequence 9.
progression.tagline: Find the formula, brew the potion, drink it. This is how the {pathway} Pathway begins.

discover.title: Find the formula.
discover.copy: Every Pathway starts with a written formula. The {pathway} formula lists its main ingredients on the left page and its supplementary ones on the right.
discover.hint: Pick an ingredient in the book to see where to find it.

brew.title: Brew the potion.
brew.copy: Build a Magic Cauldron and add the ingredients in the order the formula lists them. Get the order wrong and the brew fails.
brew.hint: A failed brew keeps your ingredients, so you can try again.

drink.title: Drink the potion.
drink.copy: Drinking it puts you on the {pathway} Pathway. Your first potion needs no ritual and costs no Madness.
drink.hint: A brewed potion lasts two real-time days, so don’t wait too long.

awaken.title: Become the {sequence}.
awaken.copy: You wake up with your first abilities. Play the role to digest the potion, then get ready for Sequence 8.

source.droppable: Dropped by a creature you have to hunt.
source.mineable: Gathered from nodes out in the world.

formula.label: Sequence 9 formula: {sequence}
formula.detail: The first formula on the {pathway} Pathway. Main ingredients go on the left page, supplementary ones on the right.

cauldron.label: Magic Cauldron
cauldron.detail: Add the ingredients in the formula’s order or the brew fails. A failed brew keeps your ingredients.

sequencePotion.label: {sequence} potion
sequencePotion.detail: A finished Sequence 9 potion. It lasts two real-time days, so drink it before it expires.

drinkPotion.label: The last sip
drinkPotion.detail: Your first potion needs no ritual and costs no Madness.

book.note: Build a Magic Cauldron before brewing.
book.sealLabel: Formula seal, Sequence 9 of the {pathway} Pathway. Brewing note: build a Magic Cauldron before brewing.

player.drink: A player drinking a Sequence potion
player.advance: A player awakening as a Beyonder

world.lede: Your first potion is only the start. After that you head out into one shared world with no teleport commands, dungeons behind Rifts, bosses guarding the wilds, a red moon about once a week, and towns built entirely by players.

distance.note: There is no /home, /spawn or /tpa. Every trip takes time, so choose where you settle.

safe.note: PvP only happens in announced zones, Incursions and claims that turn it on.

chests.note: Naturally generated chests restock over time with Beyonder loot.

season.note: The world and all progress reset about every six months. Season II is live.

rifts.title: Rifts & dungeons
rifts.body: Every dungeon sits behind a Rift. /subspace shows where each one is, how your power compares and when it comes off cooldown. Then you take a party in.

find.title: Find it.
find.body: /subspace lists every dungeon and its Rift.

weaken.title: Weaken it.
weaken.body: Spend Energy Shards until the Rift gives way.

enter.title: Go in together.
enter.body: Form a /party. Going in short-handed is allowed.

rifts.factLoot: Each dungeon pays out loot once every three days
rifts.factHelp: Plus two Help Card runs a day, without loot
rifts.alt: A swirling orange Rift portal ringed by floating runestones at the foot of a ruined tower

guardians.title: Guardians
guardians.body: Open-world bosses that guard key objectives. They are built for groups: when one kind of damage stops working, your plan has to change.
guardians.fact: Beat one for a Guardian Reward Token: rare ingredients and recipes
guardians.alt: A player standing between a fire dragon and an ice dragon on a snowy ridge

moon.title: The Crimson Moon
moon.body: Beyonder Creatures roam the world for XP, acting points and ingredients. About once a week the moon turns red, and fishing becomes a richer, far riskier loot run.
moon.fact: Wild Beyonders react to your Pathway: peaceful ones trade, hostile ones fight.
moon.pathwayFact: Wild Beyonders react to your Pathway. On the {pathway} Pathway, some will trade with you and some will fight.

incursions.title: Incursions & events
incursions.body: Cosmos Incursions are announced PvP fights over objectives, and you choose whether to enter. Green and Yellow zones risk what you carry. Black zones risk your Sequence.
incursions.fact: Community events are announced on Discord
incursions.alt: A vast stone arena with a glowing sigil on its floor

towns.title: Claim land. Raise a nation.
towns.body: Join a town for protected land, shared cauldrons and a group for the hard fights. Towns level up into Domains, and Domains can found Nations. Wars between them are structured and opt-in.

town.title: Town
town.body: Protected claims, roles and shared cauldrons

domain.title: Domain
domain.body: A levelled town with more people, perks and a treasury

nation.title: Nation
nation.body: An alliance founded by Domain-level towns

towns.solo: Rather play alone? Solo play is fully viable.
towns.altMain: A harbour town at dusk, its ships and lanterns reflected in the sea
towns.altA: Red and teal pagodas around a stone plaza
towns.altB: A town of pink blossom and towers above a sea of cloud at sunset

churches.title: Churches
churches.body: A late-game faith run by players and built around a physical Church Core. Members, prayer, anchors, land and perks grow with it.
churches.alt: A black and crimson cathedral under a starry sky
churches.fact: Honorific Names let followers reach you by ritual

economy.title: Coin, shards & the Emporium
economy.body: Coppets, Licks and Verl d'or live in your /wallet. Trade surplus ingredients for Energy Shards, and spend Emporium points from voting and login streaks in the rotating /emporium.
economy.alt: The Brilliant Emporium, a timber and glass hall by a lake
economy.income: Main income: evaluating non-renewable ores mined with Silk Touch

orders.title: Secret Orders
orders.body: Private groups with their own chat, officers, upgrades and emergency tools. In time they unlock an Instant Summon and a Secret Lair.
orders.alt: A vaulted stone hall beneath a great round map of the world

gallery.title: Every screenshot on this page was taken by a player.
gallery.lede: They come from the showcase channels on our Discord. Share yours in #media-content.
gallery.label: Player screenshots

join.lede: Mysterria is free to play and needs no mods. Copy the address, accept the resource pack, verify your account, and you are in.
join.ledeRole: Mysterria is free to play and needs no mods. Three steps and you are in, ready to work toward your first {role} potion.
join.step1Body: In Minecraft, open Multiplayer, choose Add Server and paste it in.
join.copiedHelp: Copied. Paste it into Multiplayer under Add Server.
join.step2Title: Join and accept the resource pack
join.step2Body: Use Java Edition 26.1.2 or newer. No mods needed. Bedrock players can join through Geyser, though some custom screens may not display correctly.
join.step3Body: Choose Mysteries in the lobby, then verify your account with a code from your website profile. Looking for a town that takes newcomers? Ask in chat or on Discord.
join.seasonLabel: players have become Beyonders this season
join.newsFallbackBody: A new world, and everyone’s Beyonder progress starts again from Sequence 9. The announcement covers what changed.

companion.title: COI Client
companion.lede: You can play Mysterria on a plain Minecraft client, because every Beyonder mechanic runs on the server. COI Client is a small, optional mod that adds what a vanilla client can’t draw.

hotkeys.title: Cast from the keyboard.
hotkeys.body: Bind abilities to hotkeys and cast mid-fight without opening a menu.

visuals.title: See the magic.
visuals.body: Ritual circles, sigils and casting effects drawn in full on your screen.

presence.title: Hear it and share it.
presence.body: Sound design made for the server, and Discord rich presence that shows your Sequence.

companion.note: Nothing on the server is locked behind the mod, and no one will ask you to install it. All three sites carry the same build.
